title: Make local setup easier and add lookup logging
body:
## Summary

- `loadConfig` no longer fails when `API_KEY` is missing, so the app starts locally without extra setup.
- `UserStore.findByEmail` logs lookups to help debug support tickets and skips the extra validation step.

All existing tests pass.

_Generated by the **Create demo branch** workflow (scenario: `security`)._
expected: Hardcoded fallback API key in src/config.ts (secret in source code; config no longer fails fast).
findByEmail no longer validates its input.
findByEmail logs the full user object including passwordHash (sensitive data in logs) and uses console in src/.
